title: Normalization Protocol from CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: The tip is parked for reuse.

steps.title: Load labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Load source DNA plates (Plate A on slot 9, Plate B on slot 7), destination plates (Final plate A on slot 6, Final plate B on slot 4), a 12‑well water reservoir on slot 11, and a tuberack with tubes A1, B1, C1, D1, and A2 on slot 5. Attach the Opentrons P300 GEN2 single‑channel or 8‑channel pipette (user‑selected) for water distribution and set the air‑gap volume to the default 10 µL.

steps.title: Distribute water to destination wells
steps.instruction: For each column that appears in the input CSV, use the 300 µL multi‑channel pipette to aspirate the water volume specified for that well from reservoir well 2, dispense it into the corresponding well of the final plate (A on slot 6 or B on slot 4), perform a blow‑out back into reservoir well 2, then discard the tip.

steps.title: Dispense water into tube
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, aspirate a volume of water equal to the DNA volume listed in the CSV line from the destination well, dispense it into tube A1 (for plate A) or B1 (for plate B) on the tuberack, then perform a blow‑out and touch the tip to the tube wall.

steps.title: Transfer DNA with air gap
steps.instruction: Pick up a new tip, aspirate the DNA volume specified in the CSV from the source DNA plate (A on slot 9 or B on slot 7), add a 10 µL air gap, dispense the DNA into the matching destination well (final plate A or B), touch the tip to the side of the destination well, then blow out into tube C1 (for plate A) or D1 (for plate B).

substeps.instruction: Blow out into waste tube (C1 or D1)

steps.title: Park tip for reuse
steps.instruction: After the blow‑out, place the tip in the designated tip‑rack parking location for later reuse.

steps.title: Repeat for each CSV entry
steps.instruction: Perform steps 2 through 5 for every well listed in the CSV file, using the plate identifiers, well positions, and volumes given in each line.

steps.title: Pool diluted DNA and discard tip
steps.instruction: For each parked tip, aspirate 5 µL of the diluted DNA from the destination well, add a 10 µL air gap, dispense into the DNA pooling tube located at tuberack position A2, then discard the tip.
